connector.name: Spoken by spokenmd
connector.registryDescription: Podcast transcripts as clean Markdown with real speaker names - via the Spoken API.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package spoken-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the spokenmd account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SPOKEN_API_KEY
env.description: API key from spoken.md (starts with pt_). Defaults to pt_demo (search works fully; transcripts limited to the demo episode).
